EDLP 317.description: Policy issues affecting public and private educational institutions across the PK-20 continuum (pre-school through higher education).
EDLP 317.subject: EDLP
EDLP 317.title: Law and Policy Studies in Education

EDLP 520.description: To help teachers, principals, and other personnel solve school problems by identifying and applying selected management techniques.
EDLP 520.subject: EDLP
EDLP 520.title: The Teacher as Manager

EDLP 525.description: An introduction to educational technology, its increasing importance in the total school program, and its relationship to learning theories and communication.
EDLP 525.subject: EDLP
EDLP 525.title: Resources for Teaching and Learning

EDLP 601.description: Use of theory and research to understand and improve classroom teaching. Emphasis on teacher reflection and decision-making. The administrative role in enhancing effectiveness is highlighted.
EDLP 601.subject: EDLP
EDLP 601.title: The Effective Teacher

EDLP 700.description: A survey of basic principles of school leadership, the conceptual and structural organization of public education, and an introduction to leading educational improvement.
EDLP 700.subject: EDLP
EDLP 700.title: Introduction to Education Leadership

EDLP 701.description: A study of interpersonal relations and communication within an educational organization and between the school and the community.
EDLP 701.subject: EDLP
EDLP 701.title: School Leadership

EDLP 702.description: Personnel management in the public schools with attention to such issues as teacher supply, recruitment, selection, staff development, supervision, teacher welfare, legal rights/liabilities of school personnel.
EDLP 702.subject: EDLP
EDLP 702.title: School Personnel Administration

EDLP 703.description: An introduction to the functioning of an educational supervisor. Emphasis on the improvement of instruction and instructional programs.
EDLP 703.subject: EDLP
EDLP 703.title: Supervision of Instruction

EDLP 704.description: Financial and business management functions of school administration. Local/state/national funding issues, economics and politics of school finance, budget preparation, accounting/auditing/plant operation/maintenance from school level.
EDLP 704.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: At least two of the following EDLP 700, EDLP 701, EDLP 702, EDLP 703.
EDLP 704.subject: EDLP
EDLP 704.title: School Finance and Business Management

EDLP 705.description: Emphasis on techniques of legal research, the legal relationships between the federal and state government as they relate to school district organization and administration, as well as legal case studies in all major areas of administrative concern.
EDLP 705.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: At least two of the following EDLP 700, EDLP 701, EDLP 702, EDLP 703.
EDLP 705.subject: EDLP
EDLP 705.title: Legal Basis of Educational Organization and Administration

EDLP 706.description: Principles, problems, competencies, and practices involved in the administration of schools.
EDLP 706.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: Completion 15 hours of EDLP courses prior to enrolling.
EDLP 706.subject: EDLP
EDLP 706.title: The Principalship

EDLP 707A.description: One of two courses in a required two-semester internship in the elementary schools.
EDLP 707A.subject: EDLP
EDLP 707A.title: The Elementary School Principal in Practice I

EDLP 707B.description: One of two courses in a required two-semester internship in the elementary schools.
EDLP 707B.subject: EDLP
EDLP 707B.title: The Elementary School Principal in Practice II

EDLP 709A.description: One of two courses in a required two-semester internship in the high schools.
EDLP 709A.subject: EDLP
EDLP 709A.title: The High School Principal in Practice I

EDLP 709B.description: One of two courses in a required two-semester internship in the high schools.
EDLP 709B.subject: EDLP
EDLP 709B.title: The High School Principal in Practice II

EDLP 710.description: The teacher Professional Leadership and Mentoring course focuses on coaching practices with strong evidence for improving teacher practice and student outcomes which include: observation, modeling, performance feedback, and relationship-building strategies.
EDLP 710.subject: EDLP
EDLP 710.title: Professional Leadership and Mentoring

EDLP 711.description: The Teacher Leader Practicum provides the student with opportunities to develop specific teacher leadership and coaching dispositions, knowledge, and skills considered essential to successful leadership through field-based experience (practice).
EDLP 711.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in EDLP 710.
EDLP 711.subject: EDLP
EDLP 711.title: Teacher Leader Practicum

EDLP 712.description: The first of two courses in a required two-semester internship in PK-12 school settings.
EDLP 712.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: Completion of 15 hours of approved EDLP courses.
EDLP 712.subject: EDLP
EDLP 712.title: PK-12 School Principal in Practice I

EDLP 713.description: The second of two courses in a required two-semester internship in PK-12 school settings.
EDLP 713.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in EDLP 712.
EDLP 713.subject: EDLP
EDLP 713.title: PK-12 School Principal in Practice II

EDLP 730.description: An exploration of how educational leadership is conceptualized and practiced in schools, districts, and community colleges/universities as organizations and societal institutions.
EDLP 730.subject: EDLP
EDLP 730.title: Leadership in Systems: Organizational and Institutional Theory

EDLP 731.description: A course designed to empower leaders to cultivate a culture of belonging that promotes a positive work climate that results in improved employee engagement and retention.
EDLP 731.subject: EDLP
EDLP 731.title: Inclusive Talent Management in Education– Cultivating a Work Climate for Inclusive Excellence

EDLP 732.description: Using data to inform decision-making for education leaders and scholars.
EDLP 732.subject: EDLP
EDLP 732.title: Data Informed Decision Making

EDLP 734.description: Using action research strategies and an improving science framework for continuous improvement.
EDLP 734.subject: EDLP
EDLP 734.title: Improvement Science and Action Research

EDLP 735.description: An introduction to the role of economics in evaluating education and education policy where the theory behind selected topics and the empirical evidence and methods used by economists will be discussed.
EDLP 735.subject: EDLP
EDLP 735.title: Introduction to Economics of Education

EDLP 736.description: An exploration of ethical and social justice perspectives in educational leadership, with attention to developing a personal and professional code of ethics. The role of care, professional practice, and social justice in ethics, and in moral leadership across the P-20 continuum (K12 and Higher Education).
EDLP 736.subject: EDLP
EDLP 736.title: Ethical and Social Justice Leadership

EDLP 737.description: An introduction to ideas supporting anti-racist educational leadership across the P-20 educational pipeline. Specific topics include contested definitions of racism, policy, praxis, and anti-racist research, scholarship and leadership.
EDLP 737.subject: EDLP
EDLP 737.title: Anti-racist Leadership

EDLP 738.description: A course designed to prompt students to self-reflect on who they are (including their assumptions and biases), so they can effectively lead an inclusive work environment.
EDLP 738.subject: EDLP
EDLP 738.title: Understanding the Self to promote Anti-Bias and Inclusive Leadership

EDLP 739.description: This course examines how leaders can navigate the challenges associated with promoting inclusive leadership, and highlights the opportunities associated with such efforts to promote a sense of belonging for all in the workforce.
EDLP 739.subject: EDLP
EDLP 739.title: Opportunities and Challenges Associated with Inclusive Leadership

EDLP 740.description: A course designed to empower leaders to navigate and lead change to promote inclusive excellence.
EDLP 740.subject: EDLP
EDLP 740.title: Organizational Change for Inclusive Excellence

EDLP 751.description: A seminar designed to give teachers and school administrators an opportunity to explore key legal issues.
EDLP 751.subject: EDLP
EDLP 751.title: Advanced School Law

EDLP 752.description: Open to advanced graduate students of education. History of the management, movement, and application of techniques and processes for managing the modern educational institution, emphasizing computer technology.
EDLP 752.subject: EDLP
EDLP 752.title: Computer Management in Educational Institutions

EDLP 753.description: An analysis of leadership techniques necessary to produce instructional improvement in educational organizations and of the technical methodology that distinguishes instructional supervision from other positions of school leadership.
EDLP 753.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: EDLP 703 or equivalent and employment in a position requiring supervisory responsibilities.
EDLP 753.subject: EDLP
EDLP 753.title: Advanced Methods of Instructional Supervision

EDLP 754.description: A study of principles of financing public education, analyses of revenue sources from all levels of government, existing plan of financing and possible alternatives for financing schools from district level.
EDLP 754.subject: EDLP
EDLP 754.title: Educational Finance

EDLP 755.description: An introduction to policy making in education with emphasis on the local and state levels of policy formation.
EDLP 755.subject: EDLP
EDLP 755.title: Educational Policy Analysis

EDLP 756.description: A two-semester course on the district superintendency.
EDLP 756.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: EDLP 706 and admission to EdS or PhD program.
EDLP 756.subject: EDLP
EDLP 756.title: The Superintendency

EDLP 757A.description: The first of two courses in a required two-semester internship in the district superintendency.
EDLP 757A.subject: EDLP
EDLP 757A.title: The Superintendent in Practice I

EDLP 757B.description: The second of two courses in a required two-semester internship in the district superintendency.
EDLP 757B.subject: EDLP
EDLP 757B.title: The Superintendent in Practice II

EDLP 758.description: Study of the problems involved and the procedures utilized in a comprehensive approach to planning and constructing school plants, the personnel involved and the roles they play, and the problems related to the long-term financing of such facilities.
EDLP 758.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: Admission to EdS or PhD program.
EDLP 758.subject: EDLP
EDLP 758.title: School Building Planning

EDLP 803.description: A study of the requirements, practices, problems, and opportunities of administrative evaluation of programs and personnel as required by state and federal educational legislation.
EDLP 803.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: Admission to EdS or PhD program.
EDLP 803.subject: EDLP
EDLP 803.title: Administrative Evaluation and Decision-Making

EDLP 804.description: A study of funding schemes, the economics of financing, and construction and defense of a school district budget. Microcomputers are utilized.
EDLP 804.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: EDLP 704 and EDLP 754 and PhD candidate.
EDLP 804.subject: EDLP
EDLP 804.title: Advanced Educational Finance

EDLP 805.description: Advanced study of policy making at the federal level. The class will include a mandatory week-long stay in Washington, D.C.
EDLP 805.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: EDLP 705 and EDLP 755 and PhD candidate.
EDLP 805.subject: EDLP
EDLP 805.title: Advanced Educational Policy Analysis

EDLP 806.description: Organization, leadership, motivation, and change theories as they apply to educational agencies and institutions.
EDLP 806.subject: EDLP
EDLP 806.title: Theories of Educational Leadership

EDLP 807.description: Selected topics in educational administration in either finance, administration, supervision, evaluation, policy, and financial planning/management.
EDLP 807.subject: EDLP
EDLP 807.title: Seminar in Selected Topics in Educational Administration

EDLP 808.description: This course is designed to help students identify a research literature that provides the context for their own dissertation research. Students will conduct a systematic review of this literature in order to refine their questions and methods for their dissertation research, and to build towards their own dissertation proposal and literature review chapter.
EDLP 808.subject: EDLP
EDLP 808.title: Field Problems in Educational Administration: The Literature

EDLP 809.description: Opportunity for in-depth study of selected field problems in educational administration, utilizing research and other techniques.
EDLP 809.subject: EDLP
EDLP 809.title: Field Problems in Educational Administration

EDLP 878.description: A course designed to accelerate the dissertation writing process for Education System Improvement EdD students through course readings, engaging in seminar style discussions, and writing activities.
EDLP 878.subject: EDLP
EDLP 878.title: Accelerated Dissertation in Practice Writing Course

EDLP 890.description: Independent study form required for authorization.
EDLP 890.subject: EDLP
EDLP 890.title: Independent Study
